entities.summary: Eurodicautom was the pioneering terminology database of the European Commission, launched in 1975 to support translators and staff in managing multilingual terminology. Originating from computational linguistics research at the Université libre de Bruxelles, it became one of the first large-scale digital terminology systems, initially covering six languages and expanding to eleven as the European Community grew. By 1980, it was accessible online within the Commission, and later offered public access, influencing modern translation technologies such as IATE.
